ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a cyclic schematic diagram of a butterfly life cycle, using red arrows to connect different stages. The position labeled E on the left is an adult butterfly; the position labeled C on the right is a caterpillar; the position labeled B below is a pupa/chrysalis hanging near a leaf; the position near the green leaf at the top is labeled D, and D points to a small light-yellow oval object beside the leaf. Reasoning: The question asks which stage D depicts. The butterfly life cycle usually includes egg, larva/caterpillar, pupa, and adult butterfly. The small light-yellow oval object that D points to is attached near the leaf, matching the form of butterfly eggs laid on leaves. Therefore D represents the egg stage.
